errorType.description: Classified error type for retry decision. timeout/session-lost/transient are retryable; blocked/security-block/cancelled escalate immediately; failed is retryable once then escalate.

cancellationOrigin.description: REQUIRED when status='cancelled'. Cancellation MUST originate from a user message (see references/halt-and-resume-policy.md Rule 5). Orchestrator self-cancellation is FORBIDDEN; runtime errors must use lost-session/timed-out instead.

userMessageRef.description: REQUIRED when status='cancelled'. Conversation turn id or quoted user phrase that triggered cancellation.

durationMs.description: Role execution wall-clock time in milliseconds

retryCount.description: Number of retries for this role

securityBlocks.description: Security issues that blocked this role

cascadeBlock.description: When this role is blocked, which downstream roles are cascaded

blockedRoleId.description: The role ID that caused the cascade block

cascadedRoleIds.description: Downstream roles that should be blocked as a result

checkpointArtifacts.description: Snapshot paths of key artifacts at this checkpoint for potential rollback

partialRetry.description: P6-10: Partial failure micro-retry record. Non-null when a role partially failed and was retried for specific outputs only.

failedOutputs.description: Subset of expectedOutputs that failed on first attempt

retryScope.description: Whether retry was scoped to failed outputs only (partial) or full re-execution (full)

retryAttempt.description: Which retry attempt this partial retry represents

recoveredOutputs.description: Outputs successfully recovered after partial retry

stillFailing.description: Outputs that still failed after retry (escalation needed)

tokenUsage.description: P6-13: Actual token consumption for this role execution.

budget.description: Token budget allocated to this role (from ROLE_TOKEN_BUDGETS)

reverseSyncTasks.description: Reverse-sync tasks executed by this role. Used by product-analyst, documentation-writer, quality-gate-engineer, supervisor-auditor when closing PRD-vs-code drift. See references/reverse-sync-workflow.md.

prdDriftClosed.description: True only after all three drift checks (contract / requirement / trace) return pass

elicitationRounds.description: product-analyst only. Number of Progressive Elicitation rounds performed. 0 when the upstream input contract mode short-circuited elicitation.

inferredItems.description: product-analyst only. IDs of items filled by inference rather than confirmed input. Each MUST be labelled 「推断项」/「AI 推断」 in the PRD.

inputGate.description: Upstream input contract gate result (references/prd-input-contract.md). REQUIRED for product-analyst when docs/input/ exists. MUST be produced by running scripts/validate_input_contract.py, not by eyeballing the files.

verdict.description: pass = skip elicitation and produce full PRD; partial = gap list first, draft PRD for complete capabilities only; fail = do NOT produce PRD, return blocked

blocking.description: Blocking issues reported by the script (missing required files, broken traceability links)

mustGaps.description: Must-level gaps reported by the script

brokenRefs.description: IDs cited but never defined in their owning file, with file:line locations

gapListPath.description: Path to the generated gap list, normally docs/输入缺口清单.md. REQUIRED when verdict is partial or fail.
